purpose: 从可观测量、守恒律、量子/统计物理、热力学、连续介质和尺度分析形成计算策略，并在批准后生成外部计算合同与结果审查框架
entry_criteria: scientific question and decision-critical observable recorded
system conditions, constraints and available evidence classified
inputs: scientific question, observables and acceptance tolerance
system identity, composition, geometry and operating conditions
resource, licence, privacy and time constraints
artifacts: convergence, falsification, uncertainty and physical-validation plan
phases: identify degrees of freedom, state variables, conserved quantities and symmetries
select thermodynamic potential, statistical ensemble and equilibrium regime
analyse length, time and energy scales plus dimensionless groups
derive the lowest-sufficient method and justified escalation ladder
specify convergence, validation, falsification and uncertainty propagation
obtain qualified review before external execution
separate returned receipts from checked, validated and accepted conclusions
decisions: first-principles reasoning does not imply DFT for every problem
high-risk final decisions require qualified review
failure_modes: advisory plan represented as completed execution
recovery: request missing observable, conditions and evidence
return to the lowest sufficient model
compare competing mechanisms and add discriminating evidence
preserve partial artifacts and resume from the last valid state
